# awg-rest

> Production-oriented AmneziaWG 2.0 REST control plane with Postgres desired
> state, durable outbox apply, node-local agent, JWT/RBAC, and mTLS.

## Primary docs

- README.md: project overview, local run, production compose model, release notes.
- api/openapi.yaml: HTTP API contract for backend containers.
- AGENTS.md: repository-specific guidance for coding agents.

## Important code paths

- internal/api/: HTTP handlers, service layer, tenant authorization, idempotency.
- internal/domain/profile.go: AmneziaWG profile model and official AWG2 limits.
- internal/outbox/worker.go: durable outbox worker and reconciler.
- internal/nodeagent/: node-local HTTP/mTLS agent and remote executor client.
- internal/awg/: real `awg` CLI executor, fake executor, and dump parser.
- internal/render/: AmneziaWG server/client config rendering.
- deploy/compose/: local and production Docker Compose skeletons.
- deploy/docker/Dockerfile: multi-target Docker image build.

## Security summary

- Production API is intended for same-host/same-network backend containers, not public internet.
- Production worker to node-agent transport is HTTPS with mutual TLS.
- Client private keys are one-time response material only and are not returned on idempotency replay.
- Node-agent diagnostic endpoints redact private and preshared keys.
- Tenant isolation is enforced in the service layer for reads and writes.
